message.content:
A classic **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly **550 kcal** (about 2,300 joules) per sandwich.  
That figure comes from the U.S. nutrition facts label:

| Item | Calories |
|------|----------|
| Big Mac (single patty, two‑layer sesame bun, lettuce, cheese, pickles, onions, special sauce) | ~550 kcal |

> *Note:* Calorie counts may vary slightly depending on regional recipes or ingredient changes, but most sources list it around 540–560 kcal. If you’re tracking macros closely, check your local McDonald’s menu or use an app like MyFitnessPal for the exact numbers at your location.
